title: stellaria fenzlii
intro: Stellaria fenzlii, commonly known as Fenzli's starwort, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Stellaria fenzlii include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and soothe skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
